title.zh: 卷六十九 志第二十: 禮樂三
title.raw: 卷六十九 志第二十: 禮樂三 Volume 69 Treatises 22: Rites and Music 3

sentences.zh: 禮樂三 ○郊祀樂章成宗大德六年，合祭天地五方帝樂章：降神，奏《乾寧之曲》，六成：

translations.literal: Rites and Music 3 ○ Suburban Sacrifice Music. In the sixth year of the Dade era of Emperor Chengzong, music for the combined sacrifice to Heaven and Earth and the Five Directional Emperors: For the descent of the spirits, perform 《The Quiescent-Pacification Suite》, in six movements:
translations.idiomatic: Rites and Music III ○ Hymns for the Suburban Sacrifice. In Chengzong’s sixth Dade year, music for the joint offering to Heaven and Earth and the Five Directional Sovereigns: at the descent of the spirits, 《The Suite of Tranquil Peace》 is played in six sections:

translations.literal: Bells of the Round Temple, gong mode, three movements.
translations.idiomatic: Round-bell gong mode, three movements.

translations.literal: O August Lord on High, overseeing virtue, brilliant and clear.
translations.idiomatic: O sovereign Lord on High, who watches over virtue in radiant clarity.

translations.literal: Sacrificing to ancestors, receiving Heaven, governance reaching great peace.
translations.idiomatic: We sacrifice to the ancestors and receive Heaven’s mandate, until rule attains great peace.

translations.literal: Filial thoughts as the standard, suburban sacrifice presenting sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Filial devotion is our model; in the suburban rite we offer our utmost sincerity.

translations.literal: May the spirits descend, ten thousand blessings come together.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits descend to us, and every blessing gather as one.

translations.literal: Yellow Bell, jue mode, one movement.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Bell, jue mode, one movement.

translations.literal: (The lyrics are the same as before.)
translations.idiomatic: (The text is the same as before.)

translations.literal: Grand Cluster, zhi mode, one movement.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Cluster, zhi mode, one movement.

translations.literal: (The lyrics are the same as before.)
translations.idiomatic: (The text is the same as before.)

translations.literal: Maiden Wash, yu mode, one movement.
translations.idiomatic: Maiden Wash, yu mode, one movement.

translations.literal: (The lyrics are the same as before.)
translations.idiomatic: (The text is the same as before.)

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗，奏《肅寧之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: For the first offering, hand-washing, perform 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering’s ablution, 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Clear water below, bells and drums already performed.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred water stands below; bells and drums have sounded.

translations.literal: With sincerity, solemnly, ascending and descending left and right.
translations.idiomatic: In reverent trust, solemnly, we ascend and descend on either side.

translations.literal: The ruler presides there, many officers pour the libation.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign presides; many officers bear the libation forward.

translations.literal: Auspiciously purified to sacrifice, may the Lord on High partake.
translations.idiomatic: Purified for the rite we sacrifice; may the Lord on High accept the feast.

sentences.zh: 初獻升降，奏《肅寧之曲》：大呂宮

translations.literal: First offering ascent and descent, perform 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the first offering ascends and descends, 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》 is played: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: The suburban sacrifice greatly solemn, washing and offering first ascends.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban rite is deeply solemn; washed and offered, the first gift ascends.

translations.literal: Adjusting the hem with reverence, to offer the fragrant alone.
translations.idiomatic: With gathered hem and reverent bearing, we offer what is fragrant alone.

translations.literal: Solemn and harmonious, many officers; come, approach, a hundred spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and harmonious, the host of officers; come, O hundred spirits, draw near.

translations.literal: Descend blessings, receive favor, ten thousand generations shall inherit.
translations.idiomatic: Send down blessings; grant favor that ten thousand generations may inherit.

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, perform: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silken offerings, the music plays: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: Ancestral sacrifice with paired offerings, beginning the bright suburban rite.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral rite with paired offerings begins the bright suburban sacrifice.

translations.literal: Fine jade already set out, measured silks now displayed.
translations.idiomatic: The fine jade is laid out; measured silks are now arrayed.

translations.literal: Only virtue reaches Heaven, only sincerity moves the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: By virtue alone we reach Heaven; by sincerity alone we move the spirits.

translations.literal: For ten thousand years, the fine mandate is extended.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years may the glorious mandate be proclaimed anew.

sentences.zh: 迎俎，奏《豐寧之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: Welcoming the meat-stand, perform 《The Abundant-Pacification Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the offering stand is brought in, 《The Suite of Bountiful Peace》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: There is a great stand, there are washed victims.
translations.idiomatic: A great stand is set; the victims have been washed clean.

translations.literal: The ritual knife repeatedly performed, blood and fat are raised up.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred knife strikes again and again; blood and suet are lifted up.

translations.literal: The rite honors the cocoon and chestnut, the vapor reaches, still valuing the raw.
translations.idiomatic: The rite exalts the cocoon and chestnut; the essence rises, for raw savor is still prized.

translations.literal: The Lord on High draws near and halts, partaking in utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord on High draws near; in perfect sincerity He accepts the feast.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，奏《嘉寧之曲》：大呂宮

translations.literal: Pouring the offering, perform 《The Auspicious-Pacification Suite》: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring the libation, 《The Suite of Fine Peace》 is played: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: Lofty, lofty is the Grand Altar, solemn, solemn is the vast sky.
translations.idiomatic: Towering stands the Grand Altar; solemn and vast is the azure dome.

translations.literal: The spirits draw near, reverently responsive, thus communing.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits draw near; in reverent response communion is made.

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels arrayed in rows, golden liquor in their midst.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial goblets stand in rows; amber liquor fills them within.

translations.literal: The wine already harmonized and stopped, ten thousand blessings thereby united.
translations.idiomatic: The wine is tempered and ready; every blessing is joined as one.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，奏《咸寧之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: Second offering, perform 《The All-Pacification Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the second offering, 《The Suite of Universal Peace》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: The six movements already concluded, the three offerings as if ended.
translations.idiomatic: The six movements have ended; the three offerings, it seems, are complete.

translations.literal: May the spirits be intoxicated and halt, solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits drink their fill and rest, in solemn, harmonious peace.

translations.literal: Harmonious winds, auspicious clouds, adorning our suburban palace.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious winds and auspicious clouds adorn our suburban shrine.

translations.literal: Receiving this blessing and fortune, a hundred million years without end.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving this blessing and grace, for endless myriads of years.

translations.literal: Final offering.
translations.idiomatic: Final offering.

translations.literal: (The lyrics are the same as before.)
translations.idiomatic: (The text is the same as before.)

translations.literal: Withdrawing the baskets and stands, perform 《The Abundant-Pacification Suite》:
translations.idiomatic: As the baskets and stands are withdrawn, 《The Suite of Bountiful Peace》 is played:

translations.literal: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: The suburban rite already complete, the spirits fully feast.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban rite is complete; the spirits have fully feasted.

translations.literal: The baskets and stands are orderly, withdrawal not delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and stands stand in good order; nothing delays the withdrawal.

translations.literal: Many officers gallop in haste, joyous and with decorum.
translations.idiomatic: Officers hurry forward with eager step, joyous yet in proper form.

translations.literal: Then bestowing pure blessing, forever assisting the great foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Then pure blessing is granted, to uphold the great foundation forever.

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, perform: Bells of the Round Temple, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the spirits are sent off, the music plays: Round-bell gong mode.

translations.literal: The abundant sacrifice already finished, the spirit carriage turns back.
translations.idiomatic: The full sacrifice is done; the spirit carriage wheels homeward.

translations.literal: The rite harmonious and responsive, blessings descend from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Rite and harmony answer one another; blessings descend from Heaven.

translations.literal: Moving things and plants all as they should be, yin and yang without error.
translations.idiomatic: All that moves and grows is as it should be; yin and yang keep their balance.

translations.literal: The brilliant Son of Heaven, a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: The radiant Son of Heaven—may he reign for endless myriads of years.

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning, perform: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the burning-offering rite, the music plays: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: The offering extends through a hundred rites, celebration harmonizing a hundred spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The offering fulfills a hundred rites; celebration joins a hundred spirits.

translations.literal: Presenting jade on the high altar, burning firewood in the broad court.
translations.idiomatic: Jade is laid on the high altar; firewood burns in the broad courtyard.

translations.literal: Auspicious light reaching dawn, brilliant as the Jing star.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious light reaches the dawn, bright as the Banner star.

translations.literal: The spirits descend blessings, ten thousand states all at peace.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits send down blessing; every realm finds peace.

sentences.zh: 大德九年以後，定擬親祀樂章：皇帝入中壝：

translations.literal: After the ninth year of Dade, music fixed for the emperor’s personal sacrifice: The emperor enters the inner enclosure:
translations.idiomatic: After the ninth Dade year, music was set for sacrifices the emperor performed in person: as the emperor enters the inner enclosure:

translations.literal: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Brilliantly there is approach, vast and lofty above.
translations.idiomatic: Majestically He draws near, vast and sovereign on high.

translations.literal: Able to match the imperial ancestor, solemnly come to partake.
translations.idiomatic: Fit to stand beside the imperial ancestor, He comes in solemn state to feast.

translations.literal: Beginning this great suburban rite, the pattern of Heaven broad and bright.
translations.idiomatic: This great suburban rite begins; Heaven’s pattern shines broad and clear.

translations.literal: Robed in ceremonial dress at the Round Mound, lofty is the dark empyrean.
translations.idiomatic: Robed at the Round Mound, the dark heavens tower in grandeur.

translations.literal: The emperor’s hand-washing: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor’s ablution: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Careful, careful filial thoughts, bright virtue harmonizing the rites.
translations.idiomatic: With careful filial devotion, bright virtue perfects the rites.

translations.literal: Merit reaching the dark vault, there is light at the beginning of the Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Merit reaches the azure vault; light shines at the Lord’s first dawn.

translations.literal: Displaying my refined sincerity, purifying this offering wash.
translations.idiomatic: I show forth my utmost sincerity and purify this offering wash.

translations.literal: Silks and jade are laid down, forever gathering auspicious blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Silks and jade are set in place, that blessing may gather forever.

translations.literal: The emperor ascends the altar:
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascends the altar:

translations.literal: (Same as the descent-of-spirits section.)
translations.idiomatic: (Same as the descent-of-spirits section.)

translations.literal: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: Heaven’s movement is only vigorous, abundant virtue governing Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven moves with unceasing vigor; great virtue governs the sky.

translations.literal: Sun and moon, dragon emblems, bamboo frames and bell-frames suspended at the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon, dragon banners, bamboo frames and bell racks hang at the palace.

translations.literal: Dried hides and drums still bright, ritual jade bi azure and round.
translations.idiomatic: Drums of dried hide gleam bright; azure round jade bi mark the rite.

translations.literal: The spirits draw near, fragrance rising, burning smoke.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits draw near; incense rises in curling smoke.

sentences.zh: 降神，奏《天成之曲》：圜鐘宮三成

translations.literal: Descent of the spirits, perform 《The Heaven-Completion Suite》: Bells of the Round Temple, gong mode, three movements.
translations.idiomatic: At the descent of the spirits, 《The Suite of Heaven’s Fulfillment》 is played: Round-bell gong mode, three movements.

translations.literal: Abundant is Great Yuan, greatly receiving the Lord’s favor.
translations.idiomatic: How vast is Great Yuan, inheriting the Lord’s gracious favor.

translations.literal: Repaying the root, honoring sincerity, at the suburbs abundantly offering.
translations.idiomatic: To repay our origin we prize sincerity; at the suburbs we offer abundantly.

translations.literal: Dried hides and drums displayed in array, Cloud Gate’s six transformations.
translations.idiomatic: Drums of dried hide are set in array; the Cloud Gate dance has six changes.

translations.literal: The spirits draw near, coming to rest, coming to feast.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits draw near, coming to dwell, coming to feast.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘角一成大簇徵一成

translations.literal: Yellow Bell, jue mode, one movement; Grand Cluster, zhi mode, one movement.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Bell, jue mode, one movement; Grand Cluster, zhi mode, one movement.

translations.literal: Maiden Wash, yu mode, one movement.
translations.idiomatic: Maiden Wash, yu mode, one movement.

translations.literal: (The lyrics are entirely the same as before.)
translations.idiomatic: (The text is entirely the same as before.)

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗，奏《隆成之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: First offering hand-washing, perform 《The Lofty-Completion Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering’s ablution, 《The Suite of Lofty Fulfillment》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Beginning the suburban rite at the southern suburbs, a hundred spirits receive their offices.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban rite begins at the southern altar; a hundred spirits take up their charge.

translations.literal: Purification and cleanliness come first, not fragrance in the millet alone.
translations.idiomatic: Purification comes first; it is not fragrance in grain alone that matters.

translations.literal: Then pouring, then washing, the sacrificial altar is ascended.
translations.idiomatic: We pour and wash, then ascend the altar of sacrifice.

translations.literal: The Lord on High oversees and observes, the ritual without error.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord on High watches; the rite is without flaw.

translations.literal: First offering ascending the altar,
translations.idiomatic: First offering ascending the altar,

translations.literal: (Same as the descent-of-spirits section.)
translations.idiomatic: (Same as the descent-of-spirits section.)

translations.literal: Perform 《The Lofty Completion Suite》: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: 《The Suite of Lofty Completion》 is played: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: Awed and reverent is the round altar; at the yang suburb the positions are set.
translations.idiomatic: How august is the round altar; at the southern suburb we establish the ritual positions.

translations.literal: Greatly kind, greatly timely; auspicious purification makes the offering.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly gracious, greatly timely — with auspicious purification we prepare the offering.

translations.literal: Descending and ascending, reverently compliant; a hundred rites have arrived.
translations.idiomatic: We descend and ascend in reverent obedience; every rite is complete.

translations.literal: May words dwell and savor; truly gathered are the glorious affairs.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits deign to savor; all glorious rites are duly gathered.

translations.literal: Laying out jade and silks,
translations.idiomatic: Laying out jade and silks,

translations.literal: (Same as for the principal and consort positions.)
translations.idiomatic: (Same as for the principal and consort positions.)

translations.literal: Perform 《The Reverent Completion Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: 《The Suite of Reverent Completion》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: They say Heaven covers high; utmost sincerity then reaches.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven, we know, arches high — yet utmost sincerity wins access.

translations.literal: Able to sacrifice, able to perform the suburban rite; swiftly hastening are the hundred lords.
translations.idiomatic: We perform the sacrifices and suburban rites; the hundred lords press forward in haste.

translations.literal: Prepared silks are here displayed, set up with the dark-green jade disc.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual silks are laid out, topped with the blue-green jade disc.

translations.literal: May the spirits descend in peace and make us come and gain.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits descend in blessing and grant us their bounty.

sentences.zh: 司徒捧俎，奏《寧成之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: The Minister of Earth bears the meat-stand; perform 《The Tranquil Completion Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Earth bears the offering tray; 《The Suite of Tranquil Completion》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Our sacrificial beasts are already pure; our stands are filled.
translations.idiomatic: Our offerings are purified; our trays are heaped full.

translations.literal: Pipes and bells are able to harmonize; baskets and stands have fragrant aroma.
translations.idiomatic: Pipes and bells strike harmony; baskets and stands waft fragrance.

translations.literal: The spirits come to feast and savor this bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits come to feast and savor our bright virtue.

translations.literal: Forever bestow abundant blessings, as rule, as model.
translations.idiomatic: Grant lasting blessings in abundance, in proper measure and form.

sentences.zh: 昊天上帝位酌獻，奏《明成之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: At the position of August Heaven the Lord on High, pouring the offering, perform 《The Bright Completion Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the August Heaven the Lord on High position, during the libation, 《The Suite of Bright Completion》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Oh bright August Heaven, overseeing below, splendidly manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious is August Heaven, radiant in majesty over all below.

translations.literal: Pottery and gourd present sincerity; fragrance heard lies in virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Pottery and gourds present our sincerity; true fragrance is heard in virtue alone.

translations.literal: Pouring words to offer it; the spirits on high are reached.
translations.idiomatic: With libation we offer; the spirits on high draw near.

translations.literal: Descending blessings greatly together; ten thousand times, a hundred million times.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings descend in full measure — ten thousand times, a hundred million times over.

translations.literal: At the position of August Earth Spirit, pouring the offering: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the August Earth Spirit position, during the libation: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: Utmost is the Kun origin, sharing Heaven's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Utmost is the origin of Earth, sharing Heaven's virtue.

translations.literal: Enfolding and nurturing all living beings; dark merit cannot be measured.
translations.idiomatic: It enfolds and nurtures all living beings; its profound merit cannot be fathomed.

translations.literal: Combined feast at the round altar; old canon, timely model.
translations.idiomatic: Together we feast at the round altar, following the ancient rites in their season.

translations.literal: Repeatedly bestowing without bound, thereby securing the august state.
translations.idiomatic: Grant blessing without limit, and thereby bring peace to the imperial realm.

translations.literal: At the Taizu position, pouring the offering: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the Founding Ancestor position, during the libation: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: The rite greatly repays the root; at the suburbs Heaven's position is set.
translations.idiomatic: The great rite repays the origin; at the suburban altar Heaven's position is fixed.

translations.literal: August, august divine ancestor, returning to the beginning, able to match.
translations.idiomatic: Our glorious divine ancestor, returning to the source, worthily shares the altar.

translations.literal: Utmost virtue hard to name; dark merit broadly aids.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue beyond naming, profound merit that broadly sustains all.

translations.literal: The imperial canon spread as model; leading nurture where cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial canon is spread as law; he leads nurture to every place.

translations.literal: The Emperor drinks the blessing: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor receives the blessing wine: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: A special victim enjoys sincerity; complete things follow substance.
translations.idiomatic: A single victim in sincere offering; all items kept to what is essential.

translations.literal: The Lord on High dwells and savors; a hundred spirits receive their offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord on High deigns to savor; a hundred spirits take up their charge.

translations.literal: Imperial martial glory proclaimed; filial sacrifice fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial martial glory resounds; filial sacrifice is fragrant.

translations.literal: Ten thousand blessings gathered together; the people below silently aided.
translations.idiomatic: All blessings gather as one; the people below receive hidden support.

translations.literal: The Emperor entering and leaving the lesser lodge: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the Emperor enters and leaves the side pavilion: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Only Heaven is great; only the Emperor feasts the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven alone is great; the Emperor feasts the Lord on High.

translations.literal: To match ancestors and forefathers; reverently assisting spiritual blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Matching ancestors and forefathers, we reverently assist the spiritual blessings.

translations.literal: Fixing the pole, exalting merit; forever our brilliant service.
translations.idiomatic: We fix the supreme height and exalt his merit; may our bright service endure forever.

translations.literal: Ascending the center to Heaven; emblematic things all arrive.
translations.idiomatic: We ascend the central peak toward Heaven; every symbolic offering is complete.

sentences.zh: 文舞退，武舞進，奏《和成之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances; perform 《The Harmonious Completion Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw and the martial dancers advance; 《The Suite of Harmonious Completion》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Feather flutes already complete; then raise the jade axes.
translations.idiomatic: The feathered pipers have finished; now the jade axes are brandished.

translations.literal: One relaxed, one taut; not loose, not urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Now slackening, now taut — neither slack nor strained.

translations.literal: Eight tones able to harmonize; ten thousand dances have splendor.
translations.idiomatic: The eight sounds strike harmony; the myriad dancers move with splendor.

translations.literal: Forever behold its completion; pure blessing is bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: May we forever witness this fulfillment; pure blessing is granted.

sentences.zh: 亞終獻，奏《和成之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: Second and final offerings; perform 《The Harmonious Completion Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the second and final offerings, 《The Suite of Harmonious Completion》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: There is solemn suburban rite; reverently displaying silks and jade.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the suburban rite; we reverently present silks and jade.

translations.literal: Great joy is received; bearing reverence, bearing solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: We receive this great joy, reverent and solemn throughout.

translations.literal: The Lord on High dwells and savors; fragrant aroma already sated.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord on High deigns to savor; the fragrant offering is fully enjoyed.

translations.literal: Bless us without bound; aid with great blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Bless us without limit; grant us a glorious blessing.

sentences.zh: 徹籩豆，奏《寧成之曲》：大呂宮

translations.literal: Withdrawing baskets and stands; perform 《The Tranquil Completion Suite》: Great Lu, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the baskets and stands are withdrawn, 《The Suite of Tranquil Completion》 is played: Great Lu, gong mode.

translations.literal: Three offerings thereby finished; six music thereby completed.
translations.idiomatic: The three offerings are complete; the six pieces of music have all been played.

translations.literal: Already assisting the feast; withdrawing what has been set out.
translations.idiomatic: Having assisted at the feast, we withdraw what was laid before them.

translations.literal: Vastly presiding above; silently the spirits regard.
translations.idiomatic: Vastly they preside above; silently the spirits look on with favor.

translations.literal: Bright suburban rite reported complete; oh august bestowed abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The bright suburban rite is declared complete; glorious bounty is bestowed.

sentences.zh: 送神，奏《天成之曲》：圜鐘宮

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits; perform 《The Heaven's Completion Suite》: Bells of the Round Temple, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the spirits are sent off, 《The Suite of Heaven's Completion》 is played: Round-bell gong mode.

translations.literal: The spirits' coming savor, as if at left and right.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits come to savor us, they seem at our left and right.

translations.literal: The spirit guardian now returns; spirit banners front and rear.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit guardian now departs; spirit banners lead and follow.

translations.literal: Vast, vast the upper round; without sound, without scent.
translations.idiomatic: Vast is the circle above — without sound, without scent.

translations.literal: Daily oversight greatly bright; thinking august, much aid.
translations.idiomatic: Daily watching in brilliant clarity; may we think on the august and receive much aid.

sentences.zh: 望燎，奏《隆成之曲》：黃鐘宮

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning; perform 《The Lofty Completion Suite》: Yellow Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the burning-offering rite, 《The Suite of Lofty Completion》 is played: Yellow Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Glorious affairs completely accomplished; rite pattern luxuriant.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious rites are fully complete; the ritual pattern shines in splendor.

translations.literal: Purple smoke now ascends; spirit light below illuminates.
translations.idiomatic: Purple smoke rises; spirit light shines down from above.

translations.literal: Spirits and people rejoice in peace; forever receiving abundant blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits and people rejoice in peace, forever receiving abundant blessings.

translations.literal: Grace our great peace; bright mandate has attendants.

translations.literal: The great altar receives light; vast and boundless, dark and dim.

translations.literal: Clear and bright we spread illumination; feasting rites only great.
translations.idiomatic: We spread clarity and brightness; the feast rite is supreme in grandeur.

translations.literal: Nine domains reverently proclaim; voice and teaching without outside.
translations.idiomatic: The nine domains reverently proclaim; voice and teaching reach every border.

translations.literal: The Emperor bows to Heaven's aid; shining oversight arrives at this time.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor bows to Heaven's blessing; radiant oversight reaches this moment.

translations.literal: Ancestral temple music sections.
translations.idiomatic: Hymns for the Ancestral Temple.

translations.literal: Taizu, first chamber:
translations.idiomatic: Founding Ancestor, first chamber:

translations.literal: Heaven hangs down spirit regard; Earth presents the central square.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven bends with spiritual regard; Earth offers the central square.

translations.literal: Imperial power whereof extended; divine martial none can match.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial force he spread; his divine martial prowess none could withstand.

translations.literal: Yang Stream, Dark Valley; all submit to remote wilderness.
translations.idiomatic: From the Bright Stream to the Dark Valley, all the far borders submit.

translations.literal: Display filial piety, bright suburban rite; divine ancestor august, august.
translations.idiomatic: He showed filial piety in the bright suburban rite; the divine ancestor shines gloriously.

translations.literal: Taizong, second chamber:
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, second chamber:

translations.literal: Karakorum's splendid domain; Heaven's city, Earth's palace.
translations.idiomatic: Karakorum's splendid domain — a city of Heaven, a palace of Earth.

translations.literal: Four directions, guests and tribute; north and south come together.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and tribute came from the four quarters; north and south arrived as one.

translations.literal: A hundred offices separately established; helmet education first exalted.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred offices were established in division; military education was first exalted.

translations.literal: Adorn and polish ancestral enterprise; virtue looked up to divine ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: He polished the ancestral enterprise; his virtue looks up to the divine forebear.

translations.literal: Ruizong, third chamber:
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong, third chamber:

translations.literal: Precious talisman silently granted; long ago from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: A precious token was silently granted from Heaven long ago.

translations.literal: Thereby born sacred martial; precious throne opened first.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred martial prowess was born; the precious throne was opened first.

translations.literal: Rainbow banners return from hunt; dragon carriage roams immortals.
translations.idiomatic: Rainbow banners return from the royal progress; the dragon carriage roams among the immortals.

translations.literal: Pursue the distant as if living; imperial yearning solemnly so.
translations.idiomatic: We honor the distant dead as if they lived; the Emperor's longing is solemn and deep.

translations.literal: Imperial elder uncle father Jochi, fourth chamber:
translations.idiomatic: Imperial honored uncle-father Jochi, fourth chamber:

translations.literal: Martial might like soaring hawk; ancestral position able and fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Martial might soared like a hawk; he worthily filled the ancestral place.

translations.literal: Following the dragon, far extending; ten thousand thousand li of territory.
translations.idiomatic: Following the dragon, he pushed far outward — realms of ten thousand li.

translations.literal: Born to command tiger hosts; stationed pressing the western region.
translations.idiomatic: He was born to command tiger hosts, stationed to hold the western lands.

translations.literal: Sailing sea, scaling mountains; east and west come as kings.
translations.idiomatic: By sea and by mountain path, rulers east and west came to pay homage.

translations.literal: Imperial elder uncle father Chagatai, fifth chamber:
translations.idiomatic: Imperial honored uncle-father Chagatai, fifth chamber:

translations.literal: Heroic martial army might; ever more through many years.
translations.idiomatic: Heroic martial might and army prestige grew through many years.

translations.literal: Deep counsel, far strategy; jointly assisting with sole dedication.
translations.idiomatic: Deep counsel and far-reaching strategy — his joint assistance was wholly devoted.

translations.literal: Flowing sands, Western Regions; sun-farewell eastern marches.
translations.idiomatic: From the shifting sands of the Western Regions to the eastern marches where the sun is seen off.

translations.literal: A hundred states feared and submitted; heroic renown blazed resplendent.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred states feared and submitted; his heroic fame blazed resplendent.

translations.literal: Dingzong, sixth chamber:
translations.idiomatic: Dingzong, sixth chamber:

translations.idiomatic: Through three reigns he received Heaven's rest; reverent and self-restrained, he lived at ease.

translations.literal: Reverently continuing ancestral martial ways; his virtue was grandly cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently he continued the ancestral path; his virtue was richly cultivated.

translations.literal: Heaven was willing to grant long life; virtue and favor expected to be complete.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven was willing to grant him long life; his virtue and grace reached fullness.

translations.literal: Pure sacrificial food, fragrant alone; praying for feasting in the hidden realm.
translations.idiomatic: Pure offerings, fragrant alone — we pray for feast in the hidden realm.

translations.literal: Xianzong, seventh chamber:
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong, seventh chamber:

translations.idiomatic: Like a dragon leaping from hidden depths, wind and clouds joined in harmony.

translations.literal: Knew the people's suffering; the imperial heart was deeply concerned.
translations.idiomatic: He knew the people's suffering; the imperial heart was deeply troubled for them.

translations.literal: Journey to Kuimen Pass; continuing the resolve to achieve merit.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign to Kuimen Pass — continuing the resolve to win merit.

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels in reverent offering; splendid rites greatly grand.
translations.idiomatic: With sacrificial vessels we offer reverent rites; the splendid ceremony is grand indeed.

translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent without wavering; ritual bearing carefully composed.

translations.idiomatic: Baskets and stands stand in rows; bells and chimes sound as one.

translations.idiomatic: Pure in hue and whole in form — the three sacrificial beasts and five victims.

translations.literal: Ornate knives repeatedly wielded; hair singed, broth drawn.
translations.idiomatic: Ornate knives flash again and again; singed fur, rich broth drawn forth.

translations.literal: The spirits fully satiated; hear our stone chimes.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits be fully satisfied; heed our stone chimes.

translations.literal: Dwelling in savor forever; great ancestor's peace.
translations.idiomatic: May they dwell in savor forever; great peace for our forefathers.

sentences.zh: 烈祖第一室，奏《開成之曲》：無射宮

translations.idiomatic: Illustrious Ancestor, first chamber: 《The Suite of Opening Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: O august Illustrious Ancestor; accumulated thickness flows long.
translations.idiomatic: O august Illustrious Ancestor — merit piled deep, flowing far.

translations.literal: Great merit not yet gathered; harmonizing campaigns deployed.
translations.idiomatic: Great merit was not yet complete; auxiliary campaigns were launched.

translations.literal: Sincerely born sacred heir; suddenly possessing many regions.
translations.idiomatic: A sacred heir was truly born; he suddenly held many lands.

translations.literal: Grant us bright blessing; ten thousand ages without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us glorious blessing — endless through ten thousand ages.

translations.literal: Taizu, second chamber, perform 《The Martial-Completion Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Founding Ancestor, second chamber: 《The Suite of Martial Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Heaven supports flourishing fortune; mixing-unifying central glory.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven upheld a flourishing destiny; he unified All-under-Heaven.

translations.literal: Then there was the True Man, rousing himself from Dragon Sands.
translations.idiomatic: Then arose the True Man, stirring from the Dragon Sands.

translations.literal: Sacrificing to Heaven, opening the realm; spanning seas as home.
translations.idiomatic: He sacrificed to Heaven and opened the realm; seas everywhere became his domain.

translations.literal: First established suburban rites; ten thousand ages without limit.
translations.idiomatic: He first established the suburban rites; his line without end through the ages.

sentences.zh: 太宗第三室，奏《文成之曲》：無射宮

translations.literal: Taizong, third chamber, perform 《The Literary-Completion Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, third chamber: 《The Suite of Literary Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Continue and complete former brilliance; settle the great design.
translations.idiomatic: He carried on former brilliance and settled the great design.

translations.literal: Rites and writing simplified; prohibitions wide and sparse.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual was simplified; prohibitions were broad and lenient.

translations.literal: Return wind to utmost antiquity; ascend to the age of Huaxu.
translations.idiomatic: Customs returned to primordial age; the world rose to an age of peace.

translations.literal: Three numina harmoniously aligned; four seas without worry.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven, Earth, and humanity harmonized; the four seas knew no trouble.

translations.idiomatic: Imperial honored uncle-father Jochi, fourth chamber: 《The Suite of Assisting Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Divine branch outstanding; western soil granted enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: A divine branch stood outstanding; the western lands received his fief.

translations.literal: Founding enterprise arduous; assisting our ancestors and forefathers.
translations.idiomatic: The founding enterprise was hard; he aided our ancestors.

translations.literal: Ordering kinship drew near; reckoning merit also exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Kinship was ranked close at hand; his merit too was exalted.

translations.literal: Spring and autumn sacrifices; ten thousand ages all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and autumn sacrifices — the same through ten thousand ages.

translations.idiomatic: Imperial honored uncle-father Chagatai, fifth chamber: 《The Suite of Coordinated Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Jade genealogy near kin; divine branch honored kin.
translations.idiomatic: By the jade genealogy he was near kin; an honored branch of the divine line.

translations.literal: Reckoning virtue, granting fief; extending kinship, dividing jade.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue was weighed and fiefs granted; kinship was extended and honors shared.

translations.literal: Assisting our ancestors; wind-combed, rain-washed.
translations.idiomatic: He aided our ancestors, weathering wind and rain.

translations.literal: Formerly sharing their toil; now sharing this blessing together.
translations.idiomatic: Once he shared their labor; now he shares this blessing.

sentences.zh: 睿宗第六室，奏《明成之曲》：無射宮

translations.literal: Ruizong, sixth chamber, perform 《The Bright-Completion Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizong, sixth chamber: 《The Suite of Bright Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Divine ancestor founded enterprise; then donned martial garb.
translations.idiomatic: The divine forebear founded the enterprise; then he took up arms.

translations.literal: Sacred father commanded armies; acting in Heaven's awe in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred father commanded the armies, bearing Heaven's awe in his stead.

translations.literal: South of the River settled; north of the River came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The lands south of the River were settled; the north of the River submitted.

translations.literal: Bequeathing counsel to wing the son; successive generations renewed glory.
translations.idiomatic: He left counsel to wing his heirs; generation after generation renewed glory.

translations.idiomatic: Dingzong, seventh chamber: 《The Suite of Radiant Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Heir receives great throne; accumulated harmony, renewed brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited the great throne; harmony piled high, brilliance renewed.

translations.literal: Hall framework already fixed; draped hands, non-action.
translations.idiomatic: The hall was already built; he ruled with folded hands and effortless ease.

translations.literal: Border posts at leisure; fields and hamlets secure and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The borders were at rest; fields and hamlets knew peace.

translations.literal: Savor this suburban sacrifice; ten thousand ages altogether fitting.
translations.idiomatic: May they savor this suburban rite — fitting for ten thousand ages.

translations.literal: Gentle gentle spirit music; virtue's sound not forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Gentle spirit-music sounds; his virtuous fame is not forgotten.

translations.idiomatic: Fortune opened and glory spread; the domain had grown vast.

translations.literal: Reverent respectful sacrificial affairs; aromatic wine fragrant sweet-grass.

translations.literal: Virtue by dance figures; achievement by song raised.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue shown in the dance's figures; achievement praised in song.

translations.literal: Thus sing and dance; spirits enjoy this augustness.
translations.idiomatic: We sing and dance together; the spirits partake of this august feast.

translations.literal: Sincerity connects, grace descends; spirit compassion bright proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Sincerity reaches through and grace descends; divine compassion is brightly proclaimed.

translations.literal: Left and right bright mandate; six compassions great all.
translations.idiomatic: Bright commands on every side; the six directions are made whole.

translations.literal: Sip and drink pepper fragrance; pure blessing like stream.
translations.idiomatic: We sip the spiced wine; pure blessing flows like a river.

translations.literal: Emperor's person life grain; hundred million such years.
translations.idiomatic: Long life to the sovereign — for countless ages to come.

translations.idiomatic: Three offerings and nine musical sections — the rite is complete and the music ceases.

translations.literal: At stands at offerings; there quietly withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and offerings in place — now all is quietly withdrawn.

translations.literal: Many officers diligent private; music and moreover have ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Many officers serve in diligence; music and ritual proceed in order.

translations.literal: Able affairs emerge from sheath; greatly gracious greatly timely.
translations.idiomatic: Each task is skillfully carried through; grace abounds at every turn.

translations.literal: Cloud chariot's coming; not fast yet swift.
translations.idiomatic: When the cloud-chariot came, it was not hasty yet arrived swiftly.

translations.idiomatic: The wind-borne carriage turns homeward, fading into stillness and mist.

translations.literal: Spirits' hearts' joy; filial grandson's salary.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits rejoice in their hearts; blessings fall upon the filial descendant.

translations.literal: Yan yi without bounds; glorious mandate has attendants.
translations.idiomatic: May lasting protection know no bounds; the bright mandate has its followers.

translations.idiomatic: Shizu, third chamber: 《The Suite of Blended Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: How bright the imperial ancestor; body strong, riding Qian.
translations.idiomatic: How bright our imperial forebear, strong in body, mounted on Heaven's throne.

translations.literal: Dragon flies responding to fortune; great virtue shines before.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon rose to meet Heaven's mandate; his great virtue lit the ages before.

translations.literal: Divine achievement settled in old age; grace covers the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: His divine achievement was settled; his grace reached the four corners of the earth.

translations.literal: Bequeath to his descendants the plan; how many thousand ten-thousands of years.
translations.idiomatic: He left counsel for his descendants — may it endure for endless ages.

sentences.zh: 裕宗第四室，奏《昭成之曲》：無射宮

translations.literal: Yuzong, fourth chamber; perform 《The Manifest-Completion Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzong, fourth chamber: 《The Suite of Manifest Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Heaven opened deep benevolence; must wait for the age to flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven opened deep benevolence; his age had to come before glory could flourish.

translations.literal: Looking back to illustrious father; dare not lag in spreading light.
translations.idiomatic: We recall our illustrious forebear and dare not delay in spreading his glory.

translations.literal: Emblematic rites first raised; rites complete, sounds clang.
translations.idiomatic: The emblematic rites are first performed; every observance is complete and the music rings clear.

translations.literal: Imperial spirits observe and stop; send down blessing without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: May the imperial spirits look down upon us and send blessings without end.

sentences.zh: 順宗第六室，奏《慶成之曲》：無射宮

translations.literal: Shunzong, sixth chamber; perform 《The Celebrated-Completion Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzong, sixth chamber: 《The Suite of Joyful Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Dragon hidden in the deep; virtue manifest in Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon lay hidden in the deep; his virtue shone in Heaven.

translations.literal: Receiving restful foundation mandate; light covers the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He received the mandate of a settled foundation; his glory spread across the realm.

translations.literal: Abundant abundant as if present; baskets, stands, sacrificial animals.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant as though he were present; baskets, stands, and offerings are laid out.

translations.literal: Only bright only fragrant; imperial fortune extends continuously.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and fragrant is the offering; may the imperial fortune extend without end.

translations.idiomatic: Chengzong, seventh chamber: 《The Suite of Preserved Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

sentences.zh: 天開神聖，繼世清寧，澤深仁溥，樂協《韶英》。

translations.literal: Heaven opened sacred sagehood; succeeding age pure and peaceful; grace deep, benevolence broad; music harmonizes with 《Shao Ying》.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven opened a sacred reign; he succeeded to a peaceful age; grace ran deep and benevolence spread wide; music harmonized with the Shao and Ying.

translations.literal: Clan branches fine assembly; qi harmonious only fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: The clan branches gather in fine assembly; harmony fills the air with fragrance.

translations.literal: Abundant blessing comes; forever covered by imperial spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant blessing descends; may we forever receive the imperial spirits' protection.

sentences.zh: 武宗第八室，奏《威成之曲》：無射宮

translations.literal: Wuzong, eighth chamber; perform 《The Majestic-Completion Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong, eighth chamber: 《The Suite of Majestic Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Continuing Heaven's great enterprise; succeeding age abundant peace.
translations.idiomatic: He continued Heaven's great enterprise; his age knew abundant peace.

translations.literal: Grace reaches the Central Kingdom; authority pacifies the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: His grace reached the Central Kingdom; his authority pacified the frontier.

translations.literal: His achievement only lush; pure temple settles the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: His achievement was abundant; in the pure temple his spirit rests in peace.

translations.literal: Enjoy this bright sacrifice; blessing and salary come to completion.
translations.idiomatic: May they delight in this bright sacrifice; may blessing and fortune come to fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 仁宗第九室，奏《歆成之曲》：無射宮

translations.idiomatic: Renzong, ninth chamber: 《The Suite of Delighted Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Continuing and exalting former thread; fortune opens civilization.
translations.idiomatic: He continued and exalted the work of his forebears; his reign opened an age of civilization.

translations.literal: Deep benevolence reaching things; utmost filial piety personally practiced.
translations.idiomatic: Deep benevolence reached all living things; utmost filial piety he practiced himself.

translations.literal: Only the emperor establishes the standard; great virtue hard to name.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign alone established the standard; his great virtue is beyond naming.

translations.literal: Dwelling in enjoyment ten thousand sacrifices; blessing and salary lofty completion.
translations.idiomatic: May he dwell in blessing through endless generations; may fortune and honor reach their height.

sentences.zh: 英宗第十室，奏《獻成之曲》：無射宮
