translations.idiomatic: Yingzong, tenth chamber: 《The Suite of Offered Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Sacred sagehood succeeding creation; this is the model and law.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred rule succeeded in turn; this is the model and law.

translations.literal: Grandly raising rites and music; personally attending seasonal and autumn sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He grandly raised rites and music and personally attended the seasonal sacrifices.

translations.literal: Carefully carefully pure temple; blazing has bright light.
translations.idiomatic: The pure temple stands in solemn splendor, blazing with bright light.

translations.literal: For a thousand ten-thousands of years; generations look up to bright goodness.
translations.idiomatic: For endless ages generations will look up to his bright excellence.

sentences.zh: 皇帝飲福，登歌樂奏《釐成之曲》：夾鐘宮

translations.literal: Emperor drinks blessing; ascending song music performs 《The Rectifying-Completion Suite》: Interposed Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the Emperor partakes of the blessing, the ascending chorus plays 《The Suite of Blessing Completion》: Interposed Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Solemn solemn Son of Heaven; suburban sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn stands the Son of Heaven, performing suburban sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

translations.literal: Rites complete, music prepared; reverence withdraws, sincerity connects.
translations.idiomatic: Rites and music are complete; reverent withdrawal reaches through in sincerity.

translations.literal: Spirits all rejoice and stop; bestow upon them rich wine.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits all rejoice; rich wine is bestowed upon them.

translations.literal: Son of Heaven ten thousand generations; blessing and salary without end.
translations.idiomatic: Long life to the Son of Heaven for endless generations; may fortune know no bounds.

translations.literal: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances; perform 《The Solemn-Completion
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw and the martial dancers advance; perform 《The Solemn Completion

translations.literal: (Kong's original text has 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》.)
translations.idiomatic: (Kong's original text has 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》.)

translations.literal: Suite》.
translations.idiomatic: Suite》.

sentences.zh: 〈（至元四年，名《和成之曲》，詞律同。）〉

translations.literal: (Fourth year of Zhiyuan, titled 《The Harmonious-Completion Suite》; lyrics and meter same.)
translations.idiomatic: (In Zhiyuan year 4 it was titled 《The Suite of Harmonious Completion》; the text and meter are the same.)

sentences.zh: 亞終獻行禮，宮縣奏《肅成之曲》。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings perform the rite; full orchestra performs 《The Solemn-Completion Suite》.
translations.idiomatic: At the second and final offerings the rite is performed; the full orchestra plays 《The Suite of Solemn Completion》.

sentences.zh: 〈（至元四年，名《順成之曲》，詞律同。）〉

translations.literal: (Fourth year of Zhiyuan, titled 《The Smooth-Completion Suite》; lyrics and meter same.)
translations.idiomatic: (In Zhiyuan year 4 it was titled 《The Suite of Smooth Completion》; the text and meter are the same.)

sentences.zh: 徹籩豆，登歌樂奏《豐寧之曲》。

translations.literal: Withdraw baskets and stands; ascending song music performs 《The Abundant-Pacification Suite》.
translations.idiomatic: As the baskets and stands are withdrawn, the ascending chorus plays 《The Suite of Bountiful Peace》.

sentences.zh: 〈（至元四年，名《豐成之曲》，詞律同。）〉

translations.literal: (Fourth year of Zhiyuan, titled 《The Abundant-Completion Suite》; lyrics and meter same.)
translations.idiomatic: (In Zhiyuan year 4 it was titled 《The Suite of Abundant Completion》; the text and meter are the same.)

translations.literal: Sending off spirits; perform 《The Preserved-Completion Suite》.
translations.idiomatic: At the sending off of the spirits, 《The Suite of Preserved Completion》 is played.

sentences.zh: 〈（至元四年，名《來成之曲》，詞律同。）〉

translations.literal: (Fourth year of Zhiyuan, titled 《The Coming-Completion Suite》; lyrics and meter same.)
translations.idiomatic: (In Zhiyuan year 4 it was titled 《The Suite of Attained Completion》; the text and meter are the same.)

sentences.zh: 皇帝出廟廷，奏《昌寧之曲》：無射宮

translations.literal: Emperor exits the temple court; perform 《The Flourishing-Pacification Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the Emperor leaves the temple court, 《The Suite of Flourishing Peace》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: Continually bright, only pure; auspicious purification brings sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Ever bright and pure; in auspicious purification we offer our sincerity.

translations.literal: Supreme rites all raised; bright virtue presents fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: The supreme rites are fully performed; bright virtue offers fragrant tribute.

translations.literal: Affairs finished and complete; joy connects the three spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is finished; joy reaches the three spirits.

translations.literal: Forefathers are august; come to feast, come to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Our forefathers are august; come to feast, come to dwell in peace.

sentences.zh: 文宗天歷三年，明宗祔廟酌獻，奏《永成之曲》：無射宮

translations.literal: Third year of Tianli of Wenzong, Mingzong enshrined in temple libation offering; perform 《The Eternal-Completion Suite》: Pitchless, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: In Wenzong's third Tianli year, at libation for Mingzong's enshrinement in the ancestral temple, 《The Suite of Eternal Completion》 is played: Pitchless, gong mode.

translations.literal: How great the imperial brilliance; generations continue divine martial prowess.
translations.idiomatic: How great the imperial brilliance; generation after generation he continued divine martial prowess.

translations.literal: Revering Heaven without transgression; at times hidden, at times on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Revering Heaven without transgression; now in seclusion, now on campaign.

translations.literal: Dragon banner on the road; saying he received all the land.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon banner was on the road; he received the allegiance of all the realm.

translations.literal: Not far, he drew near; forever bestow great blessing.
translations.idiomatic: He drew near without delay; may great blessing be forever granted.

sentences.zh: 社稷樂章降神，奏《鎮寧之曲》：

translations.literal: State and Grain Altars music, descent of spirits; perform 《The Subduing-Pacification Suite》:
translations.idiomatic: Music for the State and Grain Altars, descent of the spirits: 《The Suite of Settled Peace》 is played:

translations.literal: Forest Bell, gong mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Forest Bell, gong mode, two movements.

translations.literal: With the altars of soil and grain; the state has canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: For the altars of soil and grain the state has its canonical rites.

translations.literal: Great is the primal virtue; foundation fortune extends far.
translations.idiomatic: Great is the primal virtue; the foundation of fortune extends far.

translations.literal: Agricultural work ten thousand generations; here repay the root.
translations.idiomatic: Agricultural labor sustains ten thousand generations; here we repay the source.

translations.literal: Manifest assistants silently bless; descend to oversee the altar platform.
translations.idiomatic: Manifest assistants silently bless; they descend to oversee the altar.

translations.literal: Grand Cluster, jue mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Cluster, jue mode, two movements.

translations.literal: Bestow upon the people earth's benefit; its achievement very broad.
translations.idiomatic: He bestowed earth's benefit upon the people; the achievement was very broad.

translations.literal: Bright age canonical rites; clear sounds and pitch pipes.
translations.idiomatic: The bright age's canonical rites sound in clear tones and pitch pipes.

translations.literal: Good day at the appointed time; abundant abundant they come down.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed good day they come down in abundance.

translations.literal: Look upon this abundant year; root and foundation daily firm.
translations.idiomatic: Behold this abundant year; root and foundation grow firmer day by day.

translations.literal: Maiden Wash, zhi mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Maiden Wash, zhi mode, two movements.

translations.literal: Level their water and soil; hundred grains thereby accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: He leveled water and soil; the hundred grains thereby flourished.

translations.literal: Long supporting the glorious fortune; fitting to enjoy virtuous fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Long may he support the glorious fortune; fitting that we enjoy virtuous fragrance.

translations.literal: The five sacrifices are greatest; through a thousand ages performed.
translations.idiomatic: Among sacrifices the five are greatest; they have been performed through the ages.

translations.literal: Moved and connected in reverent communion; ascending song subdues peace.
translations.idiomatic: Moved in reverent communion, the ascending chorus sings of settled peace.

translations.literal: Southern Palace, yu mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Palace, yu mode, two movements.

translations.literal: Silks complete, reverently prepared; grain offerings declared ready.
translations.idiomatic: Silks are complete and reverently prepared; grain offerings are declared ready.

translations.literal: Granaries mound-high; by whose gift?
translations.idiomatic: Granaries mound high — by whose gift is this?

translations.literal: Lofty altar shows reverence; hidden light very near.
translations.idiomatic: At the lofty altar we show reverence; hidden light draws very near.

translations.literal: Enjoyed in pure sincerity; auspicious blessings all arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Offered in pure sincerity; every auspicious blessing arrives.

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗，奏《肅寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: First offering hand-washing; perform 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering's ablution, 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Rites complete, music arrayed; time good, day auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Rites are complete and music arrayed; the time is good and the day auspicious.

translations.literal: Ladle from those goblets and jars; fragrant are the millet and grain.
translations.idiomatic: We ladle from the goblets and jars; fragrant are the millet and grain.

translations.literal: Wash and pour, raise reverence; cloths and covers.
translations.idiomatic: Washed and poured with reverence; cloths and covers are prepared.

translations.literal: Ten thousand years solemn sacrifice; orderly they receive their offices.
translations.idiomatic: For endless ages the solemn sacrifice continues; orderly they receive their offices.

translations.literal: First offering ascends the altar; perform 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》:
translations.idiomatic: As the first offering ascends the altar, 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》 is played:

translations.literal: (Same as the descent-of-spirits section.)
translations.idiomatic: (Same as the descent-of-spirits section.)

translations.literal: Respond Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: Respond Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Spring prayer, autumn thanksgiving; ancient and modern canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: Spring prayer and autumn thanksgiving are the canonical rites of ancient and modern times.

translations.literal: The people rely on Heaven; spirits and gods thereby manifest.
translations.idiomatic: The people rely on Heaven; the spirits thereby manifest their power.

translations.literal: Merit exalted, rites strict; people abundant, age peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Merit is exalted and rites are strict; the people flourish and the age is peaceful.

translations.literal: Harmonious harmonious as ritual; burn fragrant incense.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonious is the ritual; fragrant incense is burned.

sentences.zh: 正配位奠玉幣，奏《億寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Principal and paired positions set out jade and silks; perform 《The Myriad-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the principal and paired positions jade and silks are set out; 《The Suite of Myriad Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Earth spirits turn toward virtue; examine antiquity for fine recompense.
translations.idiomatic: Earth spirits turn toward virtue; we look to antiquity for the fine recompense of sacrifice.

translations.literal: Silks and cloths here displayed; jade scepters and tablets properly colored.
translations.idiomatic: Silks and cloths are displayed; jade scepters and tablets are properly arrayed.

translations.literal: Both blazing and burning; meat and delicacies sent to announce.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing and burning, meat and delicacies are offered in announcement.

translations.literal: Rain and sunshine timely as if; great plan forever preserved.
translations.idiomatic: May rain and sunshine come in season; may the great design be forever preserved.

sentences.zh: 司徒捧俎，奏《豐寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Minister of Earth holds meat-stand; perform 《The Abundant-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Earth bears the offering tray; 《The Suite of Bountiful Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Our crops already alike; all the people broadly receive virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Our crops are alike; all the people broadly receive its benefit.

translations.literal: Our sacrifice how; sacrificial animals very large.
translations.idiomatic: How is our sacrifice? The sacrificial animals are very large.

translations.literal: Having wings, having strictness; following direction, spreading color.
translations.idiomatic: Orderly and strict, each in place according to rank.

translations.literal: Repay achievement, seek blessing; its ritual without error.
translations.idiomatic: We repay achievement and seek blessing; the ritual is without error.

sentences.zh: 正位酌獻，奏《保寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Principal position libation offering; perform 《The Preserving-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the principal position during libation, 《The Suite of Preserved Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Different ages, same virtue; how august the sage brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Different ages share the same virtue; how august the sage brilliance.

translations.literal: Send down this fine auspiciousness; guard our great treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Send down this fine auspiciousness; guard our great treasure.

translations.literal: Life is the multitude of people; matching virtue covers and nurtures.
translations.idiomatic: Life is the multitude of people; matching virtue covers and nurtures all.

translations.literal: Its performance libation offering; there is assisting conduct.
translations.idiomatic: In performing the libation offering, there is proper assisting conduct.

sentences.zh: 配位酌獻，奏《保寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Paired position libation offering; perform 《The Preserving-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the paired position during libation, 《The Suite of Preserved Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: To honor the field ancestor; the imperial house's ordered sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: To honor the field ancestor is the imperial house's ordered sacrifice.

translations.literal: Having people and folk; why not investigate the root beginning?
translations.idiomatic: Where there are people, should we not investigate the root beginning?

translations.literal: Only ordering, only cultivation; who truly mediates and stops?
translations.idiomatic: Only in ordering and cultivation; who truly stands as mediator?

translations.literal: Wine fine and abundant; great virtue fitting to pair.
translations.idiomatic: The wine is fine and abundant; great virtue is fitting to pair with it.

sentences.zh: 亞終獻，奏《咸寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Second and final offerings; perform 《The All-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the second and final offerings, 《The Suite of Universal Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: To lead and to assist; come to dwell, come to feast.
translations.idiomatic: To lead and assist; come to dwell, come to feast.

translations.literal: Stands and baskets, sacrificial animals penned; orderly and practiced.
translations.idiomatic: Stands, baskets, and penned sacrificial animals; all is orderly and practiced.

translations.literal: Properly respond to the spirits' blessing; spirits also bestow favor.
translations.idiomatic: We properly respond to the spirits' blessing; the spirits also bestow favor.

translations.literal: Soil and grain are relied upon; accomplish this recompense offering.
translations.idiomatic: We rely upon soil and grain; thus we complete this recompense offering.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，奏《豐寧之曲》：應鐘宮

translations.literal: Withdraw stands; perform 《The Abundant-Pacification Suite》: Respond Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the stands are withdrawn, 《The Suite of Bountiful Peace》 is played: Respond Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Civil governance cultivated and bright; mutually completing agricultural achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Civil governance is cultivated and bright; together they complete agricultural achievement.

translations.literal: Achievement is specially outstanding; ritual is specially exalted.
translations.idiomatic: The achievement is specially outstanding; the ritual is specially exalted.

translations.literal: End like the beginning; sincerity then can connect.
translations.idiomatic: The end is like the beginning; with sincerity one can connect.

translations.literal: Bright spirits do not forget; seasons harmonious, years abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Bright spirits, do not forget; may seasons be harmonious and years abundant.

sentences.zh: 送神，奏《鎮寧之曲》：林鐘宮

translations.literal: Sending off spirits; perform 《The Subduing-Pacification Suite》: Forest Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the sending off of the spirits, 《The Suite of Settled Peace》 is played: Forest Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Without a house receiving yang; what the state reveres and honors.
translations.idiomatic: Without a house it receives the yang; it is what the state reveres and honors.

translations.literal: To raise the coming year; buds splendid, firm grain.
translations.idiomatic: To raise the coming year; may buds be splendid and grain firm.

translations.literal: Cloud carriage do not stop; spirits attentively listen.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud carriage, do not linger; spirits, listen attentively.

translations.literal: Glorious mandate has attendants; with the state equally eternal.
translations.idiomatic: The bright mandate has its followers; may they endure as long as the state.

sentences.zh: 望瘞位，奏《肅寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Gazing at the burial place; perform 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the burial-offering rite, 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Elegant performance solemn peace; abundant blessing descends.
translations.idiomatic: The elegant performance is solemn and peaceful; abundant blessing descends.

translations.literal: Baskets of black and yellow; cinnabar sincerity blazing bright.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets of black and yellow are filled; cinnabar sincerity blazes bright.

translations.literal: Beginning sacrifice to return; looking, words within reach.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice begins its return; gazing, the spirits seem within reach.

translations.literal: Ten thousand years forever blessed; greatly receiving imperial virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Blessed for endless ages; greatly receiving the imperial virtue.

sentences.zh: 先農樂章降神，奏《鎮寧之曲》：

translations.literal: First Farmer music, descent of spirits; perform 《The Subduing-Pacification Suite》:
translations.idiomatic: Music for the First Farmer, descent of the spirits: 《The Suite of Settled Peace》 is played:

translations.literal: Forest Bell, gong mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Forest Bell, gong mode, two movements.

translations.literal: People born in this world; food is their Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: People are born into this world; food is their Heaven.

translations.literal: Reverently considering the great sage; fully devoted to the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we consider the great sage, who devoted himself fully to the fields.

translations.literal: Mid-spring encourage agriculture; bright sacrifice, auspicious purification.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-spring we encourage agriculture; the bright sacrifice calls for auspicious purification.

translations.literal: Fragrant aroma moves spirits; used to pray for abundant years.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant aroma moves the spirits; we pray for abundant years.

translations.literal: Grand Cluster, jue mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Cluster, jue mode, two movements.

translations.literal: Ploughing and sowing, devoting to agriculture; from ancient times thus.
translations.idiomatic: Ploughing and sowing, devoting oneself to agriculture — from ancient times it has been thus.

translations.literal: Thus grain for the multitude; merit and virtue lushly extend.
translations.idiomatic: Thus grain for the multitude; merit and virtue extend in abundance.

translations.literal: Send down fine offerings of hardship; what the state should do.
translations.idiomatic: Fine offerings of toil are sent down; this is what the state should do.

translations.literal: What is relied upon is only the spirits; use to purify bright grain.
translations.idiomatic: We rely upon the spirits alone; we purify the bright grain offering.

translations.literal: Maiden Wash, zhi mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Maiden Wash, zhi mode, two movements.

translations.literal: Begin planting on level fields; agricultural work first diligent.
translations.idiomatic: Planting begins on level fields; agricultural work starts with diligence.

translations.literal: A thousand pairs plough and weed; together go to low wet fields and borders.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand pairs plough and weed; together they go to the low fields and borders.

translations.literal: Field ancestor greatly numinous; in benevolence reaching the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: The field ancestor is greatly numinous; in benevolence he reached the utmost.

translations.literal: Abundant years plentiful plentiful; extending greatness has guidance.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant years overflow; greatness extends with guiding blessing.

translations.literal: Southern Bell, yu mode, two movements.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Bell, yu mode, two movements.

translations.literal: All the people labor at ploughing; reaching this, just spring.
translations.idiomatic: All the people labor at ploughing; now spring has come.

translations.literal: At this time eastern work; earnest our farmers.
translations.idiomatic: At this season of eastern work we are earnest toward our farmers.

translations.literal: Our millet already flowering; our grain should be new.
translations.idiomatic: Our millet has flowered; our grain should be fresh and new.

translations.literal: From Heaven descends peace; forever relying on bright spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Peace descends from Heaven; forever we rely on the bright spirits.

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗，奏《肅寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: First offering hand-washing; perform 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the first offering's ablution, 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Far ladle roadside water; truly enough for offering.
translations.idiomatic: We ladle from the distant roadside stream; it is truly enough for offering.

translations.literal: Present this pure clarity; spirits are here before.
translations.idiomatic: We present this pure clarity; the spirits are here before us.

translations.literal: Divide to make sweet rain; moisten and irrigate fragrant fields.
translations.idiomatic: May sweet rain be divided forth; may it moisten the fragrant fields.

translations.literal: Careful at the beginning; sincerity thereby shown.
translations.idiomatic: Be careful at the beginning; sincerity is thereby shown.

sentences.zh: 初獻升壇，奏《肅寧之曲》：應鐘宮

translations.literal: First offering ascends altar; perform 《The Reverent-Pacification Suite》: Respond Bell, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: As the first offering ascends the altar, 《The Suite of Solemn Peace》 is played: Respond Bell, gong mode.

translations.literal: Having pepper its fragrance; only abundant and fine.
translations.idiomatic: Pepper fragrance abounds; it is plentiful and fine.

translations.literal: Thus careful your ritual; descend and ascend, court stop.
translations.idiomatic: Be careful in your ritual; ascending and descending, stop at the court.

translations.literal: Millet, grain, rice, fine grain; people without thirst or hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Millet, grain, rice, and fine grain — may the people know neither thirst nor hunger.

translations.literal: Spirits delight in food and drink; forever soothe fine blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits delight in food and drink; may fine blessing forever soothe us.

sentences.zh: 正配位奠玉幣，奏《億寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Principal and paired positions set out jade and silks; perform 《The Myriad-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the principal and paired positions jade and silks are set out; 《The Suite of Myriad Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Present silks only reverent; before display fine jade.
translations.idiomatic: Present silks with reverence; fine jade is displayed before.

translations.literal: Thereby manifest grand ritual; solemn harmonious pure as.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby the grand ritual is manifest; solemn, harmonious, and pure.

translations.literal: Southern fields deeply ploughed; hemp, wheat, grain, beans.
translations.idiomatic: The southern fields are deeply ploughed; hemp, wheat, grain, and beans grow there.

translations.literal: Used to pray for three harvests; receive many blessings.
translations.idiomatic: We pray for three harvests in a year; may we receive abundant blessing.

sentences.zh: 司徒捧俎，奏《豐寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Minister of Earth holds meat-stand; perform 《The Abundant-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Earth bears the offering tray; 《The Suite of Bountiful Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Present victims very fine; ascend stand abundant and complete.
translations.idiomatic: Fine victims are presented; the offering stand is full and complete.

translations.literal: Minister of Earth swiftly runs; hurry forward in splendor.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Earth runs swiftly; hurrying forward in splendor.

translations.literal: Fat and large, multiplying; enjoy this sincere intent.
translations.idiomatic: Fat and flourishing they multiply; may they delight in this sincere intent.

translations.literal: Having years thus now; all equally receive spirit gifts.
translations.idiomatic: An abundant year is here now; all equally receive the spirits' gifts.

sentences.zh: 正位酌獻，奏《保寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Principal position libation offering; perform 《The Preserving-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the principal position during libation, 《The Suite of Preserved Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Precious altar lofty and bright; spirits respond like echoes.
translations.idiomatic: The precious altar stands lofty and bright; the spirits respond like echoes.

translations.literal: Prepared fat all have; sacrificial bodies fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: All are prepared and fat; the sacrificial bodies are fragrant.

translations.literal: Abundant abundant as if present; descend, arrive, come enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant as though present; they descend and come to enjoy the feast.

translations.literal: Uphold sincerity without slackness; all living things look up.
translations.idiomatic: Uphold sincerity without slackness; all living things look up in reverence.

sentences.zh: 配位酌獻，奏《保寧之曲》：太簇宮

translations.literal: Paired position libation offering; perform 《The Preserving-Pacification Suite》: Grand Cluster, gong mode.
translations.idiomatic: At the paired position during libation, 《The Suite of Preserved Peace》 is played: Grand Cluster, gong mode.

translations.literal: Wine clear thus fragrant; victims large thus big.
translations.idiomatic: The wine is clear and fragrant; the victims are large and fine.

translations.literal: All arrayed goblets and stands; pure intent first gathers.
translations.idiomatic: Goblets and stands are all arrayed; pure intent gathers first.

translations.literal: People's fate is only food; weeds and tares do not harm.
translations.idiomatic: The people's fate depends on food; may weeds and tares do no harm.

translations.idiomatic: Often his bowl was empty; his source ran deep indeed.

translations.idiomatic: The second sage proclaimed the plan; for a hundred generations sacrifice is fitting.

translations.idiomatic: Thus he expounded the 《Great Learning》; ten thousand tasks instruct the rule.

translations.idiomatic: Continuing the sage and guiding posterity; this enjoyment is fitting.

translations.idiomatic: He assists the primal sage; for endless ages he is exalted.

translations.idiomatic: The Way thereby arose; how august the Sagely Proclaimed One.

translations.idiomatic: Maintaining the Duke's transmission, people know to hasten toward what is right.

translations.literal: Together feasting in hall; sentiment and pattern thus fitting.

translations.idiomatic: Gazing upon it in abundance; may the spirits peacefully stop.
